Center.hypotheses: Centre-weighted non-uniformity: spin-coat or deposition thickness, CMP removal rate at the centre, plasma density in etch.
Center.check: Thickness / CD maps of the same lots; which chamber or polisher processed them.

Donut.hypotheses: Mid-radius non-uniformity: CMP pressure zones, gas distribution in deposition or etch, thermal non-uniformity in anneal / RTP.
Donut.check: Radial metrology profiles; recent maintenance on the tool.

Edge-Ring.hypotheses: Edge effects: film thickness at the edge, edge bead removal, etch rate at the edge, thermal gradient near the edge.
Edge-Ring.check: Edge exclusion settings; edge thickness profiles; edge ring wear in etch chambers.

Edge-Loc.hypotheses: Contact or shadowing on one side: clamps, handling contacts, notch alignment, edge chipping.
Edge-Loc.check: Position relative to the notch; robot / clamp contact points; repetition across lots.

Loc.hypotheses: Local event: particle or contamination, local litho focus issue, local damage.
Loc.check: Defect inspection images at those coordinates; repetition on other wafers.

Scratch.hypotheses: Mechanical damage: CMP scratches (slurry agglomerates, pad debris) or wafer handling.
Scratch.check: Scratch direction; CMP consumables and slurry filtration; handling steps between inspections.

Random.hypotheses: Diffuse contamination or a parametric shift affecting all dies.
Random.check: Particle counts; parametric test data; whether the whole lot is affected.

Near-full.hypotheses: Gross failure: wrong or aborted recipe, skipped step, severe equipment fault, test set-up problem.
Near-full.check: Lot history for aborts or reworks; retest on a known-good tester.

none.hypotheses: No systematic pattern: baseline random yield loss.
